definitions.gloss: kokuji; a kanji invented in Japan
definitions.explanation: A character made in Japan in the style of Chinese characters but not found in Chinese, such as {峠|とうげ} or {畑|はたけ}. Many have only a kun'yomi and no on'yomi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国字|こくじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Tōge is one of the kokuji.

examples.japanese: {国字|こくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音読|おんよ}み→音読み：10453_onyomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many kokuji have no on'yomi reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧や⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{目|め}にする→目にする：21472_menisuru⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{国字|こくじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Among the kanji we see every day, such as hatake and tōge, there are also kokuji.

notes:
A character made in Japan in the style of Chinese characters but not found in Chinese — for example ⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧, ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧, and ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧. Many {国字|こくじ} have only a kun'yomi (native reading) and no on'yomi.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{峠|とうげ}→峠：02227_touge⟧: mountain pass
- ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧: dry field
- ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧: to be crowded

USAGE:
{国字|こくじ} can also mean a nation's own writing system, but the 'Japanese-made kanji' sense is the usual one.
